description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of emotional categories evaluated in the context of speaker anonymization on emotional speech, with six distinct emotion labels segmented by color and percentage. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to “Frustration” at 25.1%, followed by “Neutral” in dark blue at 23.1%. “Anger,” shown in yellow, accounts for 14.9%, while “Excitement,” in red, makes up 14.1%. “Happiness,” in cyan, represents 8.1%, and “Disgust,” in orange, comprises 14.7%. The chart uses a standard circular layout with each slice labeled and its percentage value displayed inside, allowing for direct comparison of emotional prevalence in the anonymized speech dataset under evaluation. No slice is exploded or emphasized, suggesting equal visual weighting across categories.
